method.answers: Pairs per candidate; S=sat, U=unsat. First checks feasibility; second seeks a contract violation.
method.branch_counts: Joint or per-candidate feasible valuations before projecting to service. Solvers need not enumerate them.
method.compromise: First round-half-up(N*percentage/100) nodes in deterministic node order.
method.design: At each node size, all-to-all references at 25% compromise for K=1,4,16; additionally rotate candidate counts over four compromise levels and two sharing levels. At 64 nodes cross all factors. Single-candidate fanout is identical and represented once.
method.peak_memory: Three additional GNU time maximum-RSS probes for the solver child in KiB at 8,64,512 nodes with one or 16 candidates at 25% compromise. Probes excluded from all clocks in the summary.
queries: violation of safety, positive service or evidence
method.seed_use: Fixed SMT search seed; seed Python random.Random once to shuffle cell order independently in each successive warmup and measured round. Workload graph within a cell is fixed.
method.solver: One fresh, single-threaded Z3 process per cell repetition, incremental push/pop within that process. Clock includes startup, input and output.
method.statistics: Median and nearest-rank p95 per cell. Secondary median interval is [10th, 21st] of 30 observations (95.72% under stationary independent sampling).
method.timing: perf_counter_ns from typed specification construction through verdict construction. Report generation, record hashing and serialization are outside the timed section.
method.workload: Initially empty, a delivered unit fills one unit of volume over one tick. A trusted observer reads final volume.
